bootstrap_rule: First lag from 1 through 7 with absolute validation daily pooled loss differential autocorrelation below 0.2; otherwise 7. Sensitivity 3, 7, 14 days.
calendar: local delivery day is the Pacific start date of each UTC hour-ending interval
training_freeze: all outcomes at least one assumed reporting hour before earliest issue in the next window; validation selection uses only complete delivery days ending before the first test issue
